tools.name: status_in_place
tools.description: Every tracked peptide in one place, with its status and a note: use it for "which peptides are legal in Australia" or "what does WADA ban". Optionally only one status.

tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: The 26 compounds and 3 blends Peptlas tracks, with the names people search by (brands, codes, street names), each U.S. status and its page. Use it to see what is covered.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated regulatory events from the Peptlas changelog, newest first: FDA advisory votes, list changes, comment deadlines, warning letters. Optionally for one compound (or a blend, meaning all its ingredients) or since a date. Use it for "what changed" or "any news on BPC-157".

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_legal_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
